rv.q: Diagnosed as HIV positive and given only four years to live, Michael and his partner, “Slutty Dave”, are determined to make the most of their time left together, so they sell their flat and spend what little they have on enjoying themselves to the full. Fast forward to 1988, it’s Michael’s final night on earth and he plans to have one last hurrah.
There are better plays about Aids than this, but few have such an intoxicating spirit.

CRUISE is based on Jack Holden’s personal experiences volunteering in his youth at the London Gay Switchboard Helpline during the 1980s — and he deploys a particularly effective device to segue the audience into that hedonistic lost realm.
